findings.label: ExamCard badgeVariant naming drift
findings.detail: ExamCardProps.badgeVariant union includes "error", which maps correctly onto the Badge atom but diverges from the Button atom's "destructive" naming. Cosmetic consistency only; align if the team standardizes on one term.

findings.label: CoursePerformance has no colocated test
findings.detail: CoursePerformance is the only new card without a colocated test. The spec classifies it as trivial and does not require one, so this is not a gap against the acceptance criteria.
